stem: "Gahira Guru" belonged to which tribe?
expl: Gahira Guru belonged to Kanwar tribe. Swami Rameshwar Kanwar, popularly known as Gahira Guru, began to change the tribal world by spreading spirituality. He used Ramchari-tra Manas as a means to teach people the essence of 'Sanatan Dharma'. He used to meditate every day at Kailash Gupha (Kailash cave) at Samarbar. Later, he formed the organization 'Sanatan Dharma Sant Samaj' at Gahira to elevate the standard and intellect of tribal people and change the way they had been living for centuries.
